motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Snappy spring easing for all interactive UI.

components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: Primary CTA button with warm coral background and spring hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #fa6e5e; color: #ffffff; padding: 10px 18px; min-height: 44px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.92rem; border-radius: 12px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(250, 110, 94, 0.35); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Filter Category Chip
components.description: Quick-filter category pill with active/inactive states.
components.css: .ds-chip-active { background: #fa6e5e; color: #ffffff; padding: 7px 15px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 700; border: 1px solid #fa6e5e; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(250, 110, 94, 0.28); }

narrative.overview: FindCo's visual language balances radical safety transparency with warm, human hospitality. Designed for urban Indians navigating social co-activities, the interface feels friendly and approachable while maintaining bank-grade cryptographic trust cues.
keyCharacteristics: Warm Pearl Cream canvas (#faf9f6) with pure white elevated surface cards
Human geometry with generous rounded corners (8px, 12px, 16px) and circular pill tags
Mint Teal (#38b29c) and Emerald (#10b981) for cryptographic Hallmark trust
Geometric Outfit headings paired with high-legibility Plus Jakarta Sans body copy

rules.name: The Rarity of Coral Rule
rules.body: The primary coral accent (#fa6e5e) is reserved for the single highest-value CTA per view. Secondary actions use neutral or ghost borders.

rules.name: The Tabular Pricing Rule
rules.body: All prices must strictly use .tabular-nums to avoid layout jitter during live slider interactions.

rules.name: The Surface-Over-Line Rule
rules.body: Group related elements inside clear surface cards with soft elevation instead of noisy 1px dividing lines.

dos: Do maintain minimum 44×44px touch targets on all interactive elements.
Do use .tabular-nums for all dynamic numerical data and pricing.
Do enforce text-wrap: balance on headings to prevent orphan words.
donts: Don't use pure black #000 text on saturated primary colors; use crisp white #ffffff on active coral.
Don't use heavy 4px solid borders on one side of cards as a category accent (the classic AI UI tell).
Don't animate layout properties (width, height, padding, margin); animate transform and opacity instead.
Don't use cartoonish bounce keyframe easing in business UI.
